segments.en: When the souls of Israel strengthen themselves together in unity and peace and love — as one person — without any separation through any hatred or dispute — Heaven forbid. Through this they have an even greater power — to receive the light of the attainment of His G-dliness Yisburach. And they are included in one mind and a strong will — to do the will of Hashem Yisburach.
